newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 6,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 6,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 6,000 tonnes of lentils for export, an spokesman said on Friday.
He told Reuters an international call for prices had been issued and December 23 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be announced on December 24.
The spokesman said partial offers up to 1,000 tonnes could be accepted.
